site_description: A free and open-source electronic-signature platform you can self-host on serverless infrastructure.
hero_body: Start on a free serverless tier and keep your agreements, data, and operations under your control—without running a server.
guide_intro: Deploy a SignKit instance, claim its first owner, and send an agreement from the browser.
guide_deploy_body: Authenticate Wrangler, inspect the plan, and provide the registered d6e-auth client credentials through a protected stdin file. create-signkit generates the three internal secrets and installs all five with the deployment.
guide_security_title: Keep secrets off the command line
guide_security_note: The OAuth JSON must contain exactly D6E_AUTH_CLIENT_ID and D6E_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Never pass their values or Cloudflare tokens as command-line arguments. After the initial deploy, back up recovery.json and its adjacent recovery-binding.json together; create-signkit never prints the secret values.
guide_claim_body: Sign in with the address passed to --bootstrap-owner-email, then claim the empty instance. Only that verified address can complete the initial claim.
guide_step_2: Upload PDF or DOCX, or edit the Markdown source; preview and commit the revision.
guide_step_3: Add recipients, roles, language, and routing order, then mark the recipient list ready.
guide_step_4: Place signer fields on the rendered pages and publish the revision.
guide_step_5: Review the final confirmation, send, and monitor delivery and recipient decisions.
